title: Cratis AI conformance fixture
description: A deterministic conformance fixture for `cratis ai test`. The fixture lives at Evaluations/conformance/<name>/fixture.json with an optional input/ tree that seeds the working directory. Result-phase globs exclude .git/, .cratis/ and node_modules/ by default. A file_matches check fails when zero files match its path or glob. Beyond this schema, the verifier enforces: name equals the folder name; paths and globs are relative with no '..' segment and no absolute path; a command check is not allowed in the install phase; at least one non-optional result-phase check exists; every profile and language exists in .cratis/ai/profile-catalog.json.

name.description: Kebab-case fixture name; must equal the fixture folder name.

prompt.description: The task given to the agent.

profiles.description: Profile ids installed for the fixture. Empty or omitted means any. Each must exist in profile-catalog.json.

languages.description: Languages the fixture applies to. Empty or omitted means any. Each must exist in profile-catalog.json.

harnesses.description: Harnesses to run on. Omitted means every supported harness.

expected_instruction_paths.description: Relative paths of instruction files expected to be present after install.

checks.description: Deterministic checks. At least one non-optional result-phase check is required.

type.description: file_matches fails when zero files match the path or glob.

phase.description: install runs after install and before the agent; result runs after the agent. Result-phase globs exclude .git/, .cratis/ and node_modules/ by default. command is not allowed in the install phase.

path.description: Relative file path. No '..' and not absolute.

glob.description: Relative glob. No '..' and not absolute.

pattern.description: .NET regular expression. Required for file_matches and file_not_matches.

run.description: Command and arguments. Required for command.

optional.description: An optional check never fails the fixture.
